source.library: Boost Interval Arithmetic library: intersect, empty and overlap, no closed-union as interval
source.derivation_boundary: Ordering of UNSAT pair witnesses and source labels is our explicit higher-level research law, not a claim that IEEE or Boost specifies it.

owner_inspiration: juv4uk/spanda: analog measurement -> exact SENS rational
astronomy: independent observations with bounded uncertainty
horology and music: intervals for period/frequency ratios
Panini, Prolog, Advice Taker: provenance-carrying consistency or contradiction

candidate.arity: one nonempty ordered finite list of uniquely labelled closed rational intervals
candidate.arguments: [(opaque source-identity, exact lower rational, exact upper rational)] where lower<=upper; no float; labels pairwise distinct
candidate.result: SAT: exact [L,U] plus first-attaining lower and upper source identities; OR UNSAT: lexicographically earliest pair of source indices (i,j), i<j, whose closed intervals are disjoint, plus exact ordered bound values and source identities demonstrating lower>upper
candidate.law: Let L=max(all lo), U=min(all hi). When L<=U, return SAT with [L,U]; on equal extrema select the first input index for each boundary witness. When L>U, find lexicographically least (i,j), i<j, with hi_i<lo_j or hi_j<lo_i; return UNSAT and two original source indices, with lower-bound value strictly greater than upper-bound value. Empty input and invalid/imprecise rationals reject. Endpoint touching counts SAT singleton, never UNSAT.

positive_witnesses.expected: SAT [2,4], lower from b upper from a
UNSAT earliest pair a,b, lower=2 upper=1
SAT [1,3] witness a on both extrema
UNSAT earliest pair a,b despite later stronger extremes

falsifiers: Collapsing [0,1] and [2,3] into a nonempty hull [0,3] rather than contradiction
Returning extremal conflicting pair (b,d) instead of earliest (a,b) when both exist
Returning only Boolean false without two source IDs and strict exact inequality witness
Using floats or accepting lo>hi, duplicate labels, empty constraint sets
candidate.difference_from_D6: D6 INTERSECTION is general set intersection; this proposal's total observable contract additionally supplies canonical exact two-source minimal inconsistency certificate and deterministic stable source attribution on tight SAT bounds. Could still be a derived library procedure; owner selection required.
candidate.expressibility_gap: Deterministic evidence-carrying bounded-interval constraint algebra under exact Q is not equal by spelling alone to D6 INTERSECTION; algebra is composable so root status unproved.

holds.name: EXACT-INTERVAL-HULL
holds.reason: Union of disjoint intervals is not one interval; hull loses gaps and cannot replace conjunction, likely ordinary min/max derived.

holds.name: INTERVAL-AFFINE-MAP
holds.reason: Under exact rational a*x+b, negative a swaps endpoint order and sources; check as library consequence of basic arithmetic.

holds.name: DECORATED-INTERVAL
holds.reason: IEEE 1788 decorations and undefined operations carry additional validity semantics, cannot treat host floating behavior as exact rational primitive.

guards: One global D10 10-bit research stream; no automatic coordinate, no resident ratification.
Name-absence is not behavior dedup; no D1-D9 changes.
No sensor I/O, FPGA wires, CI release authority, D2 control or T5 modifications.
No canonical inventory selection or ledger changes: competing writers own serialized growth, pass owner review and source-tested proposal intake first.
